hypothesis: The first current01 collapse is contaminated by a locally moving surface. Test whether full-point cluster geometry at the natural estimated seed can identify harmful facade support automatically, rather than radial map DOR or residual-only influence.
scope: Feasibility diagnosis only: all eight inherited PR161 endpoints and both matched-seed terminal S2S arms. No recursive trajectory, full-sequence accuracy, paper ratio or new production option. No raw data acquisition. A future accepted candidate requires a frozen opt-in/default-off implementation and every full00-10 arm before any accuracy claim.

profile: For every current non-ground cluster >=2 with at least one facade feature, use every full extracted .all point in that cluster, transformed by the natural estimated S2S seed. Target is every previous .all point with cluster>=2. Against this full non-ground target, evaluate one-way nearest-point mean of the smallest floor80percent squared distances (minimum one point) for translations -3m..3m inclusive at0.05m increments along normalized seed translation. Zero seed translation or empty cluster gives an unavailable profile and keeps input. PCL float KDTree, exact source/target feature order. Every profile and cluster is retained, including uninformative/negative/boundary cases.
decision: Choose lowest cost, breaking exact ties toward smaller absolute shift then negative shift. Exclude a source facade cluster only when the optimum is strictly interior, abs(shift)>1m and best_cost<0.5*zero_cost. Fixed before running, no sweep: 3m/0.05m and80percent inherited from PR161 geometric diagnosis;1m is sqrt(native s2s_gate_sq);0.5 reuses the existing DOR object-ratio value but is a NEW cost-reduction interpretation, not a paper rule. No GT, semantic label, hand region or oracle seed enters this decision.

arms.1: Same natural seed, only remove source facade queries whose cluster passes the frozen geometric rule. Every other class, target tree, scale, prior and solver remains native. Mask fixed at initial seed, not recomputed after solver updates.

limits: A cluster translation optimum is geometric consistency, not semantic or physical motion ground truth. One-way trimmed costs can hide aperture, repeated structure, occlusion, scan density or fragmentation; a biased seed can label static support as moving. Masking source facades leaves target contamination and other classes. This diagnostic fixes original history/seed and cannot prove recursive01 recovery or explain10 gradual drift. GT is offline error evaluation only; no full-sequence or paper ratio claim. No production files/defaults/canonical results change. No threshold retuning within this study.
